description: Look up a specific email by its Truncus ID. Returns the full send record plus the event timeline (queued, sent, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, complained). Use to verify outcome of an earlier send, debug deliverability issues, or read tracked engagement.

id.description: Email ID returned by truncus_send or truncus_send_sync.

name: truncus_get_email
title: Get email details and event timeline
